# selfdoc.context

Defines the dataclasses that carry configuration, metadata, and state through the build and rendering pipeline. `BuildContext` holds project-wide settings like locale, version, theme, and output paths. `PageContext` carries per-page data including the Markdown path, resolved content, frontmatter, and navigation position. `SearchEntry` represents a single heading-level entry in the search index with title, path, body snippet, and metadata fields.

These dataclasses are the primary interface between the build orchestration in `selfdoc.build` and the HTML rendering in `selfdoc.html`. They replace what would otherwise be long parameter lists passed through multiple function calls.
